characters.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / identity-preserve.
Asset type: finished production fighter sprite atlas for Arena Criolla.
Create a NEW atlas, drawn from the real person in PHOTO 1. Photo 1 defines the exact face, hairline, age, skin tone and natural average build. IMAGE 2 shows an established ROSTER FIGHTER and defines the hand-illustrated arcade art style. Draw a new actor with their own recognizable photographic facial structure, not the person in the style atlas.
Create entirely fresh drawings which harmonize with image 2's mature, detailed, hand-inked and softly cel-shaded 2D arcade illustration. Use natural adult anatomy, fine dark contours, rich but restrained fabric folds and facial shading, readable individual facial likeness. Faces must resemble photo 1, never the style reference person's face. Avoid the current generic young superhero/cartoon face, excessively wide stance, oversized fists, bulky muscles, glossy 3D, flat vector shapes, anime or chibi. Preserve the named character and costume from the wardrobe description below; derive face and anatomy from photo 1.
OUTPUT: a landscape transparent PNG, 2:1 aspect, 2048x1024 preferred. EXACTLY EIGHT complete isolated full-body figures, FOUR equal columns and TWO equal rows. Generous clean transparent outer margins and gaps. Each figure must stay entirely within its cell including fists, hair, shoes and the extended kick. Same head size, limb lengths, face, costume and scale in all cells. Standing feet share a baseline in each row. Faces visible in a shallow three-quarter view, oriented toward an opponent on screen RIGHT, not back view or strict facial profile.
POSE ORDER: top row 0 compact natural ready guard with an individual personality, knees slightly flexed, one foot forward and both hands at mid-chest; 1 clearly raised defensive guard near the face; 2 running to RIGHT, left knee forward and right leg back; 3 running to RIGHT, RIGHT knee forward and LEFT leg back, visibly opposite stride to cell 2. Bottom row 4 tucked-knee airborne jump; 5 long straight RIGHTward punch with other hand guarding; 6 high side kick extending RIGHT, supporting leg planted; 7 recoiling hurt backward while still facing the opponent.
All eight are the SAME person. Exactly one connected opaque silhouette per figure, no detached props. Genuine transparent alpha outside silhouettes, including between legs and around fingers. NO ground shadow, colored halo, particles, painted checkerboard, backdrop, floor, grid, cell borders, names, text, wordmarks, labels or watermarks. Small non-letter costume accents are acceptable. Keep the character fully visible with a consistent natural body-to-head ratio.
SUBJECT-SPECIFIC REQUIREMENTS:
Enrique Rivas: match the actual man in photo 1: young adult with warm medium olive complexion, broad oval face, strong nearly joined dark eyebrows, dark eyes, prominent rounded nose, full cheeks and a warm realistic dimpled smile, short dense black hair, clean-shaven. Do not make him a square-jawed superhero. Keep charcoal zip jacket with restrained violet piping/panels over black shirt, blue straight jeans, plain white sneakers and a black wristwatch. Reduce the enormous violet chest lightning symbol to a tiny rounded violet non-letter stitch. Frame0 has a relaxed assured half-smile and compact balanced guard; not the same spread-leg silhouette as the old atlas.
CRITICAL: this is a fresh drawing, not an edit or recolor of the style atlas. Use mature realistic illustrated facial features from PHOTO 1, natural soft human arms, about seven head lengths in height, and individual body language. The photographed face has priority over any generic game-character face. Frame0 shoulders and chest turn somewhat toward camera, so BOTH eyes and the breadth of the face are readable, while gaze and leading foot point to screen RIGHT. Keep the pose compact and grounded rather than deep wide-legged lunges.
